description: This file contains a series of shell functions and test cases for validating 'wildmatch' pattern matching functionality, including various features like path matching, case sensitivity, recursion, and character classes.

methods.name: should_create_test_file
methods.description: Determines whether a file specified by argument can be created in the current environment, considering platform-specific restrictions.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Runs a wildmatch pattern test using a specified matching function, comparing the expected outcome.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Runs a wildmatch pattern test via 'git ls-files' command, checking for matching files in a repository context.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs comprehensive pattern matching tests across different matching modes, including glob, IGlob, pathmatch, and case sensitivity, setting up test environments and invoking matching functions.
